product_constraint: 1.5x–3x committed Decode for the same production requests; drafts 2/3; exact target state/full logits; report Prefill, TTFT, Decode and total together.

downward_budget.authority: Old matched family attribution is an opportunity envelope, not v31 latency or an expected gain.

assessment.finding: Old 40K trace D2D copies total only 0.516 GPU seconds. Control source consumes each committed row exactly once; pending bonus consumption next round is required. Original scalar-draft and retained MMA-draft acceptance counts match at 8K/40K, so no measured precision-induced acceptance loss selects draft retuning.

mechanism: A 256-thread CTA assigns four original warps to Gate and four to Up for the same sixteen output channels. Both halves share one immutable input publication and FP8/FP4 tables; each thread retains only one original projection accumulator set. Rounded BF16 Gate/Up values cross a bounded CTA-local pair buffer, then original SiLU multiplication publishes the sole live MLP input directly.

equivalence.candidate: Identical expression, scalar K subsequences, FMA order, live-root tree, tensor scale and both intermediate BF16 rounding points. Only input/table and producer-consumer ownership change.
equivalence.forbidden: No MMA reassociation, approximate SiLU, moved scale, changed activation dtype, target or draft state, acceptance policy, allocation or inventory.

resources.numerical_admission: complete original Gate/Up+SiLU outputs and guards at M2/3/4 including nonfinite/rounding cases, then complete P65 scalar prefixes/state/logits and transactions.

trade: Halves repeated input/table initialization and removes intermediate global Gate/Up publication and two launches per layer. Adds a CTA barrier across independent producer halves and bounded shared pair publication. Preserves original per-thread accumulator count. Hardware counters are not extrapolated into speedup.
reference_translation: Native scalar Gate/Up coupled-feed and existing exact BF16 SiLU publication; already studied vLLM/Marlin paired MLP producer-consumer principle. SM87 uses ordinary warps/shared memory; no new source import, runtime dependency, FLA/Mamba recurrence transformation or FlashInfer Attention change.

selection.static_gate: No spills or declared resident-CTA floor loss; no register/grid/stage scan.
selection.api_return: Immediately after minimal numerical admission: same P65/8K/40K d2 API, >3% slowdown stops. Useful direction unlocks d3 and complete lifecycle. Neutral/negative removes. No local timing campaign.
selection.expiry: Any useful dependency must compose at the next complete verifier API return or be archived. No production or target-achievement claim from local evidence.
